incidents.name: sHATE staking share inflation
incidents.notes: The HATE staking contract credited sHATE on the pre-fee amount of the fee-on-transfer HATE token, so a flash-swapped stake/unstake cycle returned more HATE than went in and the surplus was sold into the HATE/ETH pair.

sources.ref: onchain review: staking 0x8EBd6c7D2B79CA4Dc5FBdEc239a8Bb0F214212b8 created 2023-05-20T02:00:23Z by 0x7d3047d0aaffeac7eb45f04070c248bc34d89f74, unrelated to the attack sender; no EIP-1967 events, age from deployment (108.3 days). ~8 ETH x $1,632.05 at incidentTimestamp 1693907855 (DefiLlama) = $13,056; a second tx 0x8e1b0ab098c4cc5f632e00b0842b5f825bbd15ded796d4a59880bb724f6c5372 repeated the attack and is not counted.
